description:
Make the suite pass when tests share a process, as `cargo test` runs them.

## Background

`.github/workflows/ci.yml:158` runs `cargo test --workspace`, which runs a target's tests as threads of one process; `cargo-ci` runs each test in its own process through nextest. Thirteen shuffled shared-process runs (`--shuffle-seed` 1-13, at `0b4874edf`) found failures that nextest cannot see:

- `test_command_exit_codes_serve_foreground_passthrough_is_dual_form`: `Text file busy` on spawning a script the test just wrote, on 4 of 13 seeds. A thread forking while the test still holds the script open for writing keeps it busy until that child execs.
- `test_inspect_pinned_targets_lists_only_requested_paths_of_a_commit_tree` (seed 3) and `test_probe_runs_one_git_process_in_the_probed_directory` (seed 13): both use a git stand-in, and the cause is unconfirmed.
- `test_run_shutdown_sequence_keeps_a_stalled_connection_running_for_the_whole_deadline` (seed 10): `ConnectionReset` reading the closed connection.

Serial, 32-thread and hash-partitioned nextest runs of the whole workspace all pass.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One shared test-support helper writes an executable a test then runs, leaving no window for another thread's fork and using no retry around spawn; no test writes one any other way. A script stand-in runs through its interpreter where the test allows it; where a real exec is needed, this issue states how the window closes.
- [hard] REQ-02: The other three failures each have a stated cause, and each is fixed or shown to be that same race. d2b7d19b is reproduced and fixed here, or shown gone, and closed with that evidence.
- [hard] REQ-03: 20 shuffled shared-process runs of every target in the workspace, with distinct seeds, pass; the seeds and command are recorded on this issue.
title: The suite passes when tests share a process
